title: South Korea Weighs Fourth Delay of Crypto Tax, With 2029 Start Tied to U.S. Data Sharing
summary: Bitcoin Magazine South Korea Weighs Fourth Delay of Crypto Tax, With 2029 Start Tied to U.S. Data Sharing South Korea is weighing a fourth delay of its 22% crypto tax, pushing the start from January 2027 to 2029 so authorities can access U.S. trading data once Washington joins the OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework. This post South Korea Weighs Fourth Delay of Crypto Tax, With 2029 Start Tied to U.S. Data Sharing first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
